sloka: हा महाराज रामेण सततम् प्रियवादिना ।विहीनाः सत्यसन्धेन किमर्थम् विजहासि नः ॥२-६६-१८॥
transliteration: hā mahārāja rāmeṇa satatam priyavādinā ।vihīnāḥ satyasandhena kimartham vijahāsi naḥ ॥2-66-18॥

translations.english: When we were already deprived of Rama who was always pleasing and truthful, alas, o great king, why did you leave us?
